content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Design assets

Selling design assets with crypto payments represents a shift towards financial independence for digital creators. Traditional platforms impose significant fees, like Gumroad's 10% on every sale, which can significantly cut into your earnings. By utilizing infrastructure designed for crypto payments, like NOWPayments, which charges only 0.5%, creators can keep a larger percentage of their revenue. This is crucial for individuals in regions facing economic challenges, as it allows them to retain more income and reinvest in their craft.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The infrastructure for selling design assets without traditional payment processors comprises several key components. First, hosting can be managed through GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, providing a free platform for your online store. Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers can handle backend logic, automating processes like order confirmation. Payment processing is simplified through NOWPayments, which supports over 300 cryptocurrencies and streamlines the payment experience. This architecture ensures that creators have a reliable way to collect payments without relying on third-party platforms that might impose fees or restrictions.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is specifically designed for digital creators in countries where conventional payment options are not available or are too costly. If you are selling ebooks, courses, templates, or any digital products, this infrastructure allows you to operate independently. Creators in Nigeria, Kenya, and other regions can leverage this framework to establish a robust online presence without the burden of high transaction fees or dependence on unreliable platforms. This approach empowers you to focus on your work while ensuring you retain full ownership of your sales and customer data.
Keep 99.5% of your sales with lower transaction fees from NOWPayments.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The successful deployment of this system requires integrating multiple components effectively. Begin with a hosting provider like GitHub Pages for free website hosting. Use Google Apps Script for backend logic to automate processes like order fulfillment. Next, integrate NOWPayments for seamless crypto payment processing, ensuring instant payment confirmation. Data storage can be managed through Supabase or Google Sheets, allowing for easy tracking of orders. Lastly, use Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for delivering your digital products. Each component works in concert to create a streamlined sales process.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To get started with selling your design assets, first sign up for a GitHub account and create a repository for your online store. Next, set up Google Apps Script to manage your backend operations. Integrate NOWPayments to handle cryptocurrency transactions, ensuring you can accept payments in various cryptocurrencies. Load your products into the system, and ensure that your delivery mechanism, such as Google Drive, is ready to deliver files upon purchase. For a quick start, consider leveraging the Sovereign Starter Stack for a streamlined deployment in just 48 hours.

Selling an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe is achievable by using crypto payment systems. Solutions like NOWPayments allow you to accept various cryptocurrencies, ensuring you can sell your digital products without relying on traditional platforms. This method not only reduces your fees but also ensures greater accessibility for your customers worldwide.

Integrate NOWPayments for crypto payment processing to minimize fees. Prepare your product files for delivery using Google Drive.
